calibration: For each of20 GPU trajectories replay first40 saved ctrl values in fresh CPU MuJoCo initialized to identical F32 q/v/warmstart. Existing20ms calibration gates qpos5e-5/qvel.02 and all contact pairs equal apply to this common-input replay only, not 1s closed-loop trajectories.
initialization: Exact registered cold q/v castF32 for both backends; zero warmstart/appliedforces; current sensors from fresh model forward; steady prior FK/gyro/vx filters, boot2, state11=0, publiccmd fixed±.7, zeroActor/correction, actual phase guard. Same frozen nominal gain bank and paired scalar parameters.
controller: Use unchanged original/private candidate kernels, identical gain/feed/height/yaw/actuatorgain arrays. CPU controller executes on CPU Warp arrays with CPU MuJoCo sensors and plant; GPU controller uses GPU arrays and MuJoCo Warp. No hidden terrain or true-parameter controller input.
record: All pre/post q/v/sensor/ctrl, raw and accepted diag, memory, role/phase/reference, time/warmstart/contact/forces/geometry/actual actuator torque per trajectory; retain failed states and explicit error/partial completion.
analysis: Compare displacement relative to commanded flow, body velocity/wheel speed/height/attitude drift and physical/design constraints separately; report full curves and all points. No new fitted stability/error gate; static gap cannot define success. Apply original physical/design bounds and exact query gates, keep CPU/GPU divergence visible.
stop: One finite batch. No gain/feed fit, perturbation search, retry, integration extension, new experimentalFD or PPO. Failed calibration forbids backend equivalence and further PPO admission. If any original physical/design failure, close candidate for deployment and retain failure.
baseline_constructor: One frozen bank; original10offlineFD per actual cold constructor logged. Separate all failed starts and calibration from primary dynamics; never claim PPO speedup.
next: 271 source/check and single registered batch; independent raw/calibration/direction review after terminal completion. 275 next mandatory five-round review/cleanup.
limitations: Only nominal fixedcommand nodes, equilibrium initialization. No start/stop or continuous height/speed interpolation, asymmetry, disturbed stability, jumps, method novelty, formal5 or freshOOD admitted.
